china-1916:p0620_1.rationale: Lists the ranks of Mongolian chieftains (jassaks) with their Romanized Mongolian titles. The content is a textual rank system with no quantities.

china-1916:p0623_1.rationale: Roster of Mongol chieftains with their ranks, names and succession years. Textual, with dates incidental.
review_questions: Banner or tribe labels are missing from this fragment; this may be a continuation of the Inner Mongolia table.

china-1916:p0623_2.rationale: Lists the Khalkha banners by aimak and position in the guard structure. The content is textual with no quantities.
